statement: Ready pull requests needing native validation run the complete selector and offline-dependency Python suites before three ASan shards with 75-minute job deadlines. Fixture groups and each required parity and ambient receipt suite stay together; timing observations and CTest COST hints balance deterministic placement. Ordered qualification records cover all three producers with matching binary digests and exactly one ambient receipt. A failed fast lane skips all three shards and fails the required Linux / GCC ASan aggregate. Draft rejection, non-C++ path skips, required check names, main/devel pushes and manual dispatch routes are preserved.
